items.quoteZh: ## 目标 患者可在应用中申请预约，工作人员可确认或拒绝。## 背景 - 在开发#39（PR #66）时发现：创建和PATCH操作仅供服务提供者使用（患者会收到403错误），且没有requested字段

headline.zh: 给医疗服务人员做一个确认或拒绝预约请求的小工具
headline.en: A small tool for medical staff to confirm or reject appointment requests.

why.zh: 当前仅服务方能创建和修改预约，患者无法直接发起请求。
why.en: Currently only providers can create and modify appointments, preventing patients from submitting requests directly.

step.zh: 做一个简单页面让患者填写预约信息，服务人员可直接查看并回复。
step.en: Build a minimal version that solves only this one thing, then try it with 3 people scheduling appointments.
